subject: Post-call: Trial statement of work, model choices & evaluation ownership
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@voxera.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@voxera.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Trial statement of work, model choices & evaluation ownership

Thanks again for a constructive call earlier today — appreciate the clarity on your priority workflows (support triage classification + agent summarization for Spanish and Portuguese). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before I share a draft SOW: 

Highlights from today
- Primary goals: reduce triage time by 30% and achieve >85% classification accuracy on multi-lingual tickets.
- Scope: 2-week controlled trial, 10k ticket subset (50/50 English vs. ES/PT mix), real-time inference via Redwood Hosted API.
- Success signals: p95 latency < 300ms; classification F1 >= 0.85; summaries average usefulness >= 4/5 in human eval.

Model recommendation (trial roster)
- Primary: Llama-2-13B-chat (quantized 4-bit, token optimizations) — chosen for balanced instruction-following and quality at scale.
- Fallback / capacity variant: Mistral-Instruct-7B (FP16) — cheaper and faster under heavy load; will serve as automatic fallback for throughput spikes.
- Embeddings & retrieval: OpenAI-compatible static embeddings (dense) for retrieval baseline; we’ll provide an embeddings parity test.

Multilingual approach
- Serve primary requests in ES/PT with model prompt templates tuned per locale; when confidence < 0.6, fall back to English chain-of-thought with bilingual context.
- We'll run language detection on pipeline and route to locale-optimized prompts.

Evaluation plan (high level)
- Dataset: 10k tickets split 70/20/10 (train/eval/holdout) with metadata tags.
- Metrics: classification F1, summary ROUGE-L + human usefulness rating, latency p95, cost per 1k tokens.
- A/B window: 2 weeks running primary model vs. fallback routing.
- Ownership: Redwood provides eval harness + automation; Voxera to supply labeled sample and human raters for summaries.

Next steps (action items)
1) I’ll send SOW + evaluation matrix by EOD (attached draft).
2) Voxera: confirm dataset delivery timeline (expected: Oct 6).
3) Redwood SE (Priyom): can you confirm resource estimates and initial config for the trial cluster?
4) Sign SOW (DocuSign link below) to book capacity.

Attachments: VX-SOW-draft-20270930.pdf, eval-matrix-voxera-20270930.xlsx

—
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@voxera.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@voxera.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Trial statement of work, model choices & evaluation ownership

Thanks Rafael — that summary hits the mark. Two quick clarifications: 
1) Dataset: we can deliver a 7k labeled subset by Oct 6 and the remaining 3k by Oct 13. Is the evaluation harness flexible to accept incremental uploads?
2) Language mix: we actually expect a 40% ES / 10% PT / 50% EN split across the sampled set — hope that’s okay.

Daniel and I are comfortable with the model roster; our main ask is a short failover plan if latency spikes during the day.

We’ll review the SOW and get back within 48 hours.

Best,
Sofia
CTO | Voxera Labs
sofia.moreno@voxera.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@voxera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Trial statement of work, model choices & evaluation ownership

Quick update from SE side — confirmed sizing and failover options: 

Sizing & infra
- We’ll reserve a 2x A10G pool for the 2-week trial with autoscale headroom + a 1x T4 burst lane for spikes.
- Estimated cost (trial window): ~$3,200 (GPU-hours + reserved slots) — we can give a line-item in the SOW.

Failover behavior
- Primary route: Llama-2-13B-chat running on A10G. If queue depth > 12 or p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive minutes, route to Mistral-Instruct-7B on T4s automatically.
- Cache: We’ll enable prefix KV caching for repeated ticket threads to reduce tokens and lower cost.

Eval harness specifics
- Accepts incremental CSV uploads (we’ll provide uploader script).
- Human-eval UI: Redwood provides a lightweight rating interface; Voxera can invite raters.

Action items for Voxera: upload 2k starter bundle to shared GDrive so we can run a smoke test the week of Oct 4.

—
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@voxera.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@voxera.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Trial statement of work, model choices & evaluation ownership

Perfect — thanks Sofia and Daniel. I’ve attached the SOW draft and evaluation matrix (links above + DocuSign placeholder). Next steps on our side:
- I’ll update the SOW to reflect the 40/10/50 language split and incremental dataset plan.
- Priyom will kick off the smoke test as soon as the 2k starter bundle is in the shared drive.
- Marissa will line up CS support and scheduling for raters.

If you’re happy, sign the DocuSign and we’ll book the reserved capacity for Oct 11 start.

Talk soon — Rafael
